items.title: Click2Shell WordPress Flaw Lets Attackers Gain RCE With a Single Malicious Link
items.description: WordPress administrators are being urged to update after researchers disclosed Click2Shell, an exploit chain that can turn one malicious link into remote code execution (RCE) on a vulnerable website. The issue begins with a WordPress Core theme-preview weakness that silently installs an attacker-selected theme from the official directory, then becomes a server compromise when chained […] The…

items.title: BragJack Attack Lets Malicious Extensions Hijack AI Agents Across 5 Major Browsers
items.description: A new attack technique dubbed “BragJack” allows a malicious browser extension to seize trusted communication channels used by AI assistants in Chrome, Edge, Opera Neon, Comet, and Claude in Chrome.
